ana-support: 3965001111
ana-support: Hey team, SUP-2310 coming in from AcmeCorp. After an IdP change their users can SSO but admin endpoints return 403. They say roles were working yesterday.

dev-mia: 3965001120
dev-mia: Can you paste the decoded Assertion or at least AttributeStatement? Need to see attribute names and NameFormat.

ana-support: 3965001128
ana-support: Pasted decoded attribute blob from customer (sanitized):
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="http://example.com/claims/roles">
    <AttributeValue>Admin</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>

idp-elaine: 3965001135
idp-elaine: We rolled a metadata cleanup and normalized attribute names to URNs last night. We thought SPs accepted both, sorry. We can change mapping but need exact strings.

sre-sam: 3965001140
sre-sam: FYI deploy-bot shows auth-service v3.9.0 went out 2025-02-02T04:00Z which enabled saml.legacy_name_fallback=false by default. That makes attribute matching exact and NameFormat-aware.

deploy-bot: 3965001142
deploy-bot: Deployment: auth-service v3.9.0 deployed by @dev-mia \u2014 config change: saml.legacy_name_fallback=false

dev-mia: 3965001148
dev-mia: Two immediate restores: 1) IdP can emit the legacy short name 'roles' again; 2) we can add mapping on the org to map urn->roles. Fastest for customer is to map both in Console or via API.

ana-support: 3965001154
ana-support: Customer asked for exact strings to map so they can keep URNs.

dev-mia: 3965001162
dev-mia: Map these for now: 
- roles
- http://example.com/claims/roles
Console path: Console -> Settings -> SSO -> Attribute mapping -> add key 'roles' -> source attrs [http://example.com/claims/roles]
API example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/ORG_ID/sso/attribute-mapping \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"attribute_map": {"roles": ["http://example.com/claims/roles"]}}'
```

sre-sam: 3965001175
sre-sam: Runbook note: after IdP metadata or cert rotation validate these before closing: ACS URL exact match, Audience URI, NameFormat and Attribute Name exact values. Use debug endpoint to decode assertion if needed:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/debug/saml/decode \n  -F 'SAMLResponse=@saml_response_b64.txt' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer DEBUG_TOKEN'
```

idp-elaine: 3965001188
idp-elaine: We'll revert the emitted attribute to the short name 'roles' for the next 24h while we schedule a proper rollout. Thanks for the API snippet.

ana-support: 3965001196
ana-support: Customer confirmed after we added mapping and they re-logged in admin routes work again. Marking SUP-2310 resolved pending follow-up window.

sre-sam: 3965001200
sre-sam: Longterm: add a warning in the Console UI when enabling strict matching and a preflight check that tests a sample SAMLResponse so customers see mapping mismatches during metadata upload.
